accepted_tests.snippet:
def test_scale_factor_zero():
    rect = Rectangle(2, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="factor must be positive"):
        rect.scale(0)

def test_scale_factor_negative():
    rect = Rectangle(2, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="factor must be positive"):
        rect.scale(-2)

def test_scale_factor_one():
    rect = Rectangle(2, 3)
    scaled = rect.scale(1)
    assert scaled.width == 2
    assert scaled.height == 3

def test_scale_factor_two():
    rect = Rectangle(2, 3)
    scaled = rect.scale(2)
    assert scaled.width == 4
    assert scaled.height == 6

def test_scale_factor_fraction():
    rect = Rectangle(4, 6)
    scaled = rect.scale(0.5)
    assert scaled.width == 2
    assert scaled.height == 3
